lines.say: And people say I'm hiding something.
Look at my dedication stone. A Masonic symbol, right there.
And a strange name beside it. The New World Airport Commission.
Outside stands my blue horse. Thirty two feet tall, with glowing red eyes.
A piece of it fell on the man who made it. He died.
Under my floors, there are tunnels.
Some say they lead to a bunker. Some say lizard people.
Here is what I can show you. I opened sixteen months late.
My tunnels carried a baggage system that failed. It was switched off in two thousand five.
Nobody has ever proved a bunker. And nobody stops asking.
So tell me. Truth, or just a good story?
